# skills/external/

Skills imported from outside repos/plugins/sources at the user's choice.

When adding one, note the source/repo, version or commit, import date, dependencies and notable
local edits. Keep the terms of use and the attribution for any part actually copied. Being public
on GitHub does not automatically mean every part shares one license.

Record `Origin=EXTERNAL` in `.agent/SKILL_INDEX.md` (from the project root). If a skill is newly
written from a reference idea, say so clearly instead of calling it an original import.
Do not delete, move or edit the user's skills on your own; `skills/inbox/` is optional.
